properties.name: Several people can plan against one design without colliding
properties.statement: A team, not a single author, must be able to work on one design at the same time: each person able to see what the others hold, to work in a scope that does not collide with theirs, and to have genuinely overlapping work surfaced as decidable conflicts rather than silent last-writer-wins. Whether this extends to simultaneous editing with live presence, or stops at non-colliding parallel work with good merges, is deliberately not asserted here — it depends on an architecture question that is still open, and the weaker form may be what teams actually need.
